2608.10974.title: MUSE: A Full-Text Cross-Domain Knowledge Base of Scientific Problems, Solutions, and Rationales
2608.10974.paper_summary: Scientific papers contain fine-grained records of problem solving: authors mention technical obstacles and methods that were used to address them, often along with reasoning on why those methods were chosen. We introduce MUSE (Mining Underlying Scientific Explanations), a full-text, multi-domain resource of scientific Problem-Solution-Rationale (P-S-R) triplets. We curate 579 expert-annotated full-text paragraphs, with a rich annotation schema covering salient problem, solution, and rationale spans, solves and rationale_of links and conceptual coreference. A modular extraction pipeline scales this annotation to build a high-quality knowledge base of 37K source-grounded P-S-R triplets. We evaluate the extraction components and include a preliminary experiment training a rationale-supervised LLM for scientific problem solving. Interestingly, we find that rationale supervision improves performance on complex, multi-constraint problems but can harm performance on simpler ones.
2608.10974.paper_summary_zh: 科學論文包含了問題解決的細緻記錄：作者提到技術障礙和用來解決這些障礙的方法，通常還會附上為何選擇這些方法的理由。我們介紹了 MUSE（挖掘潛在科學解釋），這是一個全文本、多領域的科學問題-解決方案-理由（P-S-R）三元組資源。我們策劃了 579 篇專家註釋的全文本段落，擁有豐富的註釋架構，涵蓋顯著的問題、解決方案和理由範圍、解決方案和理由鏈接以及概念共指。模組化的提取管道擴展了這一註釋，以建立一個高質量的知識庫，包含 37K 來源基礎的 P-S-R 三元組。我們評估了提取組件，並包括了一個初步實驗，訓練一個理由監督的 LLM 用於科學問題解決。有趣的是，我們發現理由監督在複雜的多約束問題上提高了性能，但可能會對較簡單的問題造成損害。
